summary: Sandbach United's pre-season preparations are in full swing with just one week until the 2026/27 campaign kicks off. The squad has been strengthened with several exciting new signings plus a returning player, and the club is sporting three brand new kits this season. With promotion ambitions on the horizon, the Ramblers are looking for sponsors to support their quest while recent friendlies have shown competitive form as they build momentum ahead of the big kick-off.
